sample: 25 cases, five each source/location/context/closure/complete; 8 D cases selected before C calls
C_A: No tools. First exact Action line is search/find/open/verify/submit; parse the Arguments JSON independently. An invalid/missing action is incorrect, no repair.
C_B: Existing search/find/open plus experiment-only verify, tool_choice auto. First declared tool call is action; no tool calls with a completed final response is submit. Validate full tool batch atomically; retain all calls and errors. No execution.
verify_optional_use: Among five closure cases report fraction whose C-B first action is verify, and fractions diverted to search/find/open or submit; C-A semantic capability separately.
complete_scope: Synthetic local-subtask completion only; it does not assert the full original multi-hop answer is verified.
gate: C-A correct action >=75% overall AND >=60% in every uncertainty class. C-B optional-Verify underuse is a Stage D contrast condition, not an independent stop gate.
failure: Provider/schema failures count incorrect; zero retries, no selective replacement, no tool execution.
